scope: clean cached UESolDS: 9880 train, 4000 validation; independent test never opened
source_target: existing header-derived center proxy, all 17 classes; not verified experimental origins
composition: 20 amino acid fractions and natural log length, first 1022 residues matched to ESM
Pfam: all existing GA-passing memberships; train-only vocabulary; no-hit indicator; full sequence
preprocessing: standardization on fitting training rows only for dense sequence features; no scaling binary Pfam
source_conditional_families: at least two sources with >=3 train and >=3 validation proteins in same family/source cells; exploratory support selection, report all qualifying families
solubility_pooled: reuse existing clean_all_sources predictions; new fits only for source-transfer sensitivity
source_transfer: leave each source out of training, evaluate ALL fixed 4000 validation records and each existing centre; single-centre training JCSG and MCSG evaluated on all same validation strata
solubility_family_strata: training >=3/class; validation >=3/class for reporting supported AUROC; same rule for family x source; report feasibility
confidence_intervals: 200 validation homology-group bootstrap draws, seed42, fitted-model conditional, same draws paired comparisons, no validation balancing
diversity: all memberships deduplicated per protein/family or protein/clan; observed MMseqs groups are not evolutionary independence guarantees
biochemical_space: 3D quintile grid of log full length, full charge proxy, full mean KD hydropathy; bin boundaries fitted training only; tails included; descriptive coarse occupancy, no label fitting
policy_selection: label evidence and biological support only; AUROC must not select sources
reference_recovery: 24 JCSG/MCSG records: 3 length-ranked records (low/median/high) per source/split/label, deterministic ties raw_uid; exact sequence checks required
